blocks_at_once.what:
probe.py EXE OUT.json: the blocks of the force kernels the device keeps at once, as the eval binary reports them.

For every model and precision (with tables, looked up and stored, and without), one evaluation of one frame, and the
header line `force blocks at once (...)` read back. No timing.
blocks_at_once.build: omnimd-native-gpu-eval of branch force-occupancy, final build 2026-11-22 03:18 (after the first review; the code committed differs from it in comments, the tests and Device::shared_memory_per_multiprocessor, which is read once as the device opens and used by the tests only)
blocks_at_once.note: force_blocks: the blocks of the force kernel the device keeps at once in each way (wide blocks with the sums across the warps, narrow ones with them, wide ones without, narrow ones without): what one multiprocessor keeps (cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor) times the multiprocessors; per descriptor, "-" for one without (se_e3). Settings: exact nets, tables looked up by the kernels (--inline-tables on), tables stored (--inline-tables off).

notes: way_of_new is the way of the last pass of a two-body force kernel of the new build, from its bench lines: `force_threads` with `force_sums` in the second run; the build of the first run printed `block_sums`, which is that of the force kernel launched last (in the hybrid, the one of se_e3, which forms the sums in every pass; its two-body ways in these cases had the sums as well).
The forced ways set the sums with --block-sums, which sets them for every descriptor: in the hybrid, the ways forced without the sums take them from se_e3 as well.
Changes are quoted against the lesser of `old` and `old again`, which favors the build before.

first_run.what:
ways.py OLD NEW OUT.json [ROUNDS]: the force blocks chosen by the blocks the device keeps at once, before and after,
with every way forced (2026-11-22).

Two builds of omnimd-native-gpu-eval: OLD (the limits of centers) twice a round (`old`, `old again`: what the two
differ by is what the machine adds), NEW as it is (`new`) and NEW with each way of the force kernel forced
(--wide-forces 1000000 or 0 with --block-sums 1000000 or 0: `wide+sums`, `narrow+sums`, `wide`, `narrow`).
Alternated in ROUNDS rounds (5), the order reversed every other round, the least of each kept. Cases: the trained
HAP models (se_e2_a, se_e2_r, a hybrid with se_e3, a committee of four) on batches of the sealed-test frames, and
the water models on batches of frames of 192 water atoms and on 1,536, in float32 and float64, with tables (--compress 0.5) and
for se_e2_a in float32 also without; sizes on both sides of what the device keeps of each way. `centers` are the
atoms of a pass times its models. The card is checked for other users before every round (tools/ht/gpu_busy.ps1).
Environment: ONLY (words of case names, by comma).
